description: This file defines a lock-free sequence lock class used for synchronization in concurrent programming, including functions for reading and writing protected data with atomic operations.

classes.name: SequenceLock
classes.description: A lock-free sequence lock implementation for concurrent data access.

methods.name: AlignUp
methods.description: Aligns a size 'x' up to the nearest multiple of 'align'.

methods.name: MarkInitialized
methods.description: Marks the sequence lock as initialized, allowing read operations.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to read data protected by the sequence lock without blocking; returns false if the lock is uninitialized or a concurrent write occurs.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the protected data, updating the sequence counter to indicate a write in progress.

methods.name: ModificationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the lock has been written to.

methods.name: IncrementModificationCount
methods.description: Increments the modification count of the lock.
